acceptanceCriteria: Specify a bounded agent-facing check that compares proposed checkout/key/lifecycle transition with the exact governing coordinator instruction before executing cancellation or enrollment replacement.

Preserve raw observations, failed/unknown obligations and explicit non-success; require coordinator recovery adjudication when preservation boundaries were crossed, without rewriting historical state or inventing chronology.
Qualify both explicitly authorized cancellation and preserve-ACTIVE/distinct-checkout cases; keep safeguard authority separate from Core technical capability and retain limits.

title: Define an agent safeguard before cancelling an active unsatisfied enrollment for a new base
